description: Get time-series stats (throughput / latency / replicas) for a dedicated deployment. DeepInfra REST: GET /deploy/{deploy_id}/stats2.

from.description: Range start (required) — a unix timestamp or a relative expression like 'now-5h' (units: s, m, h, d, w).

to.description: Range end — unix timestamp or relative expression; defaults to now.

name: deepinfra_get_deployment_stats
title: Get deployment stats
